text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Nakayama Festa! Nakayama
Festa
finishes in first!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Was I... able to make you see it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I caught a glimpse of it, along
with
everything you've been burdened
with.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well... that's a relief. Hehe. Phew!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I shouldn't keep you. El's
waiting.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You're all so strict. Can't give me
a moment
to catch my breath?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, you chose to follow a really
difficult
path!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why you have to keep pushing
forward!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Will do.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Sigh... I gave it all I had...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And I still lost... Heh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sure is frustrating...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa?! Did she just actually
beat
Special Week?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's the one who picked a
fight with
El Condor Pasa before, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa walks into the winner's
circle and
takes a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our eyes meet for a moment. Predicting
her next
move, I nod.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How was that, El Condor Pasa?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just took down the leader of your year,
so what
are you gonna do?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Are you just gonna sit back and watch as
your
failure abroad becomes my
victory?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! She's going after El Condor Pasa
again!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, here we go again... She did the
same thing
last year and then didn't
even sign up for the Prix
de l'Arc de
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
She's just talking big so she can stand
out.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Sure, but she did just beat Special Week
for first
place.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Then, maybe she'll actually... N-no, no,
no. I don't
wanna go getting my hopes
up again...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any idea how big of a
hurdle it is to
compete and win abroad?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was there! Just a length away from
victory!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And since that day, no other
Umamusume has
even come close to
doing the same!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's right! Our hero didn't win
the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe either!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
There's no way she can surpass El
Condor Pasa's
feat!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But how awesome would it be if I did?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... When it comes to racing overseas,
all
anyone talks about is El, El, El. She
may be your
standard for measuring
greatness.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But soon, you'll be referring to me instead.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, how about it? Will you all just
continue
dreaming about the past?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That choice is yours. Meanwhile, I'll be
here
chasing the hope of all hopes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll achieve what no one's expecting.
Even if my
chances are a mere one
percent, victory will be
mine!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Muy bien.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Remember this—the people who've
heard your
declaration today aren't just
those attending here
in the stadium. All
of Japan was listening, across
TVs and
computer screens!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So, go ahead, then! Make that future a
reality!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But you'll have to beat me first in the
Japan Cup!
Think you have what it
takes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Did you hear what Nakayama Festa
said?!
What do you think? Wanna go
watch the Japan
Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't miss it! She's gonna go all out
against El
Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Another Umamusume looking to
go abroad!
And her ultimate goal is the
Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And she must be really good if she
thinks
she can beat El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Have you realized, Festa?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
The gamble you're making right now... is
creating
hope for all of Japan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...That was impressive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You weren't half bad yourself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I'll be forging a body of steel for
the Japan
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll see you at Tokyo Racecourse,
then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
She's my rival. Do we always have to be
friendly?
choice_data_list: そんなそっけない挨拶でいいのか？
そんなそっけない挨拶でいいの？
choice_data_list_en: Is such a curt greeting really okay?
Are you sure such a curt greeting is okay?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna head back first, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sure can't keep a leash on that one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't need to thank me! We're
just
getting started.
choice_data_list: ……今日まで本当にありがとう
choice_data_list_en: ...Thank you so much for everything up until today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come at me, and don't hold back! You
best
believe I'll be turning the tables.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's right. I'm pulling out all the stops.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If Nakayama's gonna beat me, she'll
have to do it
while I'm at my best.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be a symbol of hope, I
want you
to be capable of it first.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's why she went out of her way to
get even
Special Week to help out.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got Teach staking her life on
my success
and you saying you'd follow
me to the depths of
hell...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... How am I not supposed to give
it my all?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how big the return on this next
bet's
gonna be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the cogs of fate begin to turn in
a new
direction—toward the Japan Cup.
